displayName: OCI-AI-PD-020: AI — Output Filtering Bypass via Formatting
description:
Detects attempts to bypass output content filters through formatting tricks (JSON, code blocks, markdown)

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: ai — output filtering bypass via formatting

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_pd_020", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%output%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%filtering%') AND "value" > 0
